audit_scope: Remediation delta only: every ru value this remediation changed in the audited namespaces, plus the round-1 findings themselves. findings.current: {label} · {counted, plural, one {{noun}} few {{pluralnoun}} many {{pluralnoun}} other {{pluralnoun}}}: {counted, number, ::group-off}
findings.proposed: {label} · {counted, number, ::group-off} (and the same with «— показано не всё» for view_shown, or use {pluralnoun} in the one branch)
findings.reason: The remediation fixed the wrong case and restored the count, but the label-first phrase still repeats the segment label: with label «Файлы» and pluralnoun «файлы» it renders «Файлы · файлы: 3» / «Цели · цели: 4». Russian `one` also selects 21/31/101, so the one branch renders «Файлы · файл: 21», which the old count-first one branch («21 файл») got right. Dropping the repeated noun (or using {pluralnoun} in every branch) removes both symptoms; whitespace and the cap clause are otherwise correct.

findings.reason: The remediation replaced the wrong genitive singular and «шт.» with a label-first shape, but Russian `one` covers 21 (and 31, 101, …), so the one branch renders «рантайм: 21» — a singular label with a plural count. Using {pluralnoun} in the one branch too gives the consistent label-first «рантаймы: 21»; the old count-first branch («21 рантайм») was grammatical, the new one is not. Minor and visible only in the Info panel's notes/meta.

This is the second key named by round-1 minor «no_models_are_signed_in_yet / sign_in_expired_run_login: авторизация vs вход». The remediation changed only no_models_are_signed_in_yet; this value is byte-unchanged and is now the only «авторизац» left in the audited canvas namespaces, against the locale's established «вход» (Выполнен вход, Состояние входа, Вход в Radient…). Non-gating but the round-1 finding is not fully closed.

findings.proposed: source-level: pass the bound separately or make the trajectory phrase accept «{bound}{count}» before the noun, so the rare state reads «рантаймы: 5 · траектории: ≥12»
findings.reason: Acknowledged residual in the remediation commit. With the new count_noun the rare unreported>0 state renders «рантаймы: 5 · ≥траектории: 12»: the lower-bound mark sits before the label instead of the number. The locale cannot reorder {bound} into {trajectorycount} without a source change; pre-existing shape, not a new blocker, deferred with reason.

Overflow: the three compact labels (last_known, use_team, default_effort) are materially shorter than round 1, but the implementer discloses that no rendered frame was captured.
